title: 第549章 复活2第548章 复活1
lines: “让我猜猜看，你们用那具棺椁的材料制作成了武器？”男子笑着说道：“不错，挺有脑子的。可惜，虽然那东西对我是有克制作用，但你们手上的这点材料太少了，根本无法伤到我。”说完，他全身一震，那四根长矛瞬间断裂开。紧接着，他抓着断开的矛头，一根根的从身体拔了出来。
在众人的目光凝视下，只见他身上的伤口以肉眼可见的速度愈合，仅仅几秒钟的功夫，就彻底恢复过来，连一点疤痕都没留下来。见此情形，众人的脸色顿时变得难看无比，眼前这男子的变态已经超出了他们的预计。单凭他们的实力，根本不是对手。
“沈先生，现在怎么办？”季杭的目光投向了沈逸飞。众人当中，沈逸飞无疑是最有办法的人，所以，眼下只能指望他了。
沈逸飞紧皱着眉头，在众人期许的目光中，他摇了摇头，“我们来晚了！”此话一出，海流沙三人的心头俱是一沉。沈逸飞的意思很明显，即使集合他们四人的力量，也不可能制服对方。
此时，男子背负着双手，双眼扫视着众人，缓缓道：“你们的实力还算不错，我以后征战天下，需要不少人手，只要你们现在向我臣服，我不仅可以饶恕你们的性命，还能让你们拥有享不尽的荣华富贵，以及……永生！”
听到‘永生’这两个字，季杭的眼睛不由眯了眯，似乎有些意动。在这个世界上，没有几个人能拒绝永生的诱惑，谁不想拥有无尽的生命，尤其是他们这些道门中人。一旦得到了永生，就意味着权利。到时候，整个世界都将成为他们的奴仆。
“永生？”沈逸飞冷笑了笑，“永生有什么好的，别人不知道，但我早就体会过了。如果可以的话，我宁愿选择死亡。可惜，你连我死亡的权利都剥夺了。”
“这难道有什么不好的吗？”男子反问道：“不死不灭，在这个世界上，你就是神，大家都要奉你为主。从古至今，多少帝王渴求长生，可你却轻而易举的拥有了。这是上天赐给你的恩惠，你应该学会感激。”
“上天？你是不是想告诉我，你就是天？”
男子点了点头，“你说得不错，我就是天，我就是主宰众生的神。臣服于我，我可以赐予你们生，否则的话……只有死路一条，你们最好考虑清楚。”
“行了，你别废话了，任你巧舌如簧，我们都不会相信你的鬼话。在我看来，你只有死了，才是最好的结果。”说到这，沈逸飞转头看着其他三人，“你们先走，把这里的事情告诉我外面的人。”
“那你呢？”
“我留下来拖住他。”
“不行，你不是他的对手！”海流沙摇了摇头，“要走一起走，我们绝不会丢下你。”
“让他留下来善后吧。”一旁的季杭开口道：“别忘了，他也是个不死人。”
“快走！”沈逸飞催促了一声，足尖一点，身形如箭，从半空中电射而出，直往那名男子冲了过去。
见状，邵海生沉声道：“我们走吧，就算我们留在这也没什么用，还是赶快上去通知其他人。”
“呵呵！你们出得去吗？这里是我的世界，我就是主宰，没有我的允许，谁都别想逃出去。”
“那可不一定。”沈逸飞暴喝一声，一股磅礴的气势轰然爆发，氤氲的雾气从他体内疯狂涌出，弥漫半空。紧接着，那氤氲的雾气犹如一只只触手，迅速朝着四周蔓延，片刻间的功夫，整个空间都被雾气笼罩。
看到这一幕，季杭忍不住张大了嘴，“他怎么做到的？”此刻，在这片空间中，到处都充斥着沈逸飞的强大威势。不止是他们，就连那名男子的脸上都浮现出了一丝惊讶的神情。
“他，自爆了丹田！”邵海生神情凝重，一字一顿。作为一名神境强者，他很清楚，当一名神境强者自爆丹田后，实力将得到大幅度的提升。只是，沈逸飞所展现出来的恐怖实力还是让他感到震惊无比。按理来说，就算是自爆丹田，也不可能达到这种程度。
众人并不知道，沈逸飞在这个世界上存活了几千年，虽然时间在他身上停止了，无论他如何努力，他的修为都无法得到提升，但是，这些年来，他的丹田中积聚了无数灵力。拥有不死之身的一个好处就是，不用担心遭到灵力的反噬。因此，他体内凝聚的灵力早已达到一个恐怖的地步。
眼下，当这股力量爆发出来，所形成的威力绝不只是神境强者那么简单。
随着那股力量不停地蔓延扩散，在众人的头顶上方，竟然出现了无数道裂缝，就像整个空间都被撑开了一般。
“还愣着干什么，快走！”
听到沈逸飞的嘶吼声，海流沙三人终于回过神来，纷纷催动身形，朝着头顶的裂缝冲去。
“我看你们往哪走！”男子冷喝一声，单手擎天，五指慢慢握成拳头。伴随他的动作，一股无形而恐怖的威压从天地间涌现，瞬间笼罩在海流沙三人的身上。顿时，三人的身形微微一顿，竟然被禁锢在半空中，无法动弹。
“给我爆！”沈逸飞面色狰狞，全身泛起一丝血红之色，仿佛进入了狂暴状态。在他怒吼声中的，充斥在空间中的氤氲雾气轰然爆开，形成一股强悍无匹的气浪，疯狂弥漫。
转瞬之间，那股无形的威压就被驱散了许多。趁此时机，海流沙三人迅速穿过头顶的裂缝，消失得无影无踪。
此时，远在千里之外的东兰市，正躺在床上休息的江来突然坐了起来，然后起身走向窗台，举目眺望着远方，两道浓眉微微皱了起来。
就在刚才，他有一种奇特的感觉，自己身上的几颗宝石好像感应到了什么。不仅如此，那种感应非常强烈。沉思了片刻，他走出客房，敲响了隔壁房间的门。
“江先生，有什么事吗？”邹志同打开房门，问道。
“我想我知道你家大小姐会去哪了。”江来说道。既然他能感应到，想必余水溪也能感应到。

"Let me guess, you used the material of that coffin to make a weapon?" The man said with a smile: "Yes, it is quite clever. Unfortunately, although that thing has a restraining effect on me, the material you have is too little and cannot hurt me at all." After saying that, his whole body was shaken, and the four spears broke instantly. Then, he grabbed the broken spearheads and pulled them out from the body one by one.
Under the gaze of everyone, the wounds on his body healed at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just a few seconds, he completely recovered without leaving even a scar. Seeing this situation, everyone's expressions suddenly became extremely ugly. The perversion of the man in front of them had exceeded their expectations. Based on their strength alone, they are no match at all.
"Mr. Shen, what should we do now?" Ji Hang looked at Shen Yifei. Among everyone, Shen Yifei is undoubtedly the most capable person, so we can only count on him now.
Shen Yifei frowned, and under the expectant gazes of everyone, he shook his head, "We are late!" As soon as these words came out, the hearts of Hai Liusha and the other three people sank. Shen Yifei's meaning was obvious. Even if the four of them combined their strength, it would be impossible to subdue the other party.
At this time, the man put his hands on his back, scanned the crowd with his eyes, and said slowly: "You are pretty good. I will need a lot of manpower to conquer the world in the future. As long as you surrender to me now, I can not only spare your lives, but also let you have endless glory and wealth, and... eternal life!"
Hearing the word 'eternal life', Ji Hang's eyes couldn't help but narrowed, and he seemed to be moved. In this world, few people can refuse the temptation of eternal life. Who doesn't want to have endless life, especially those of the Taoist sect. Once you have eternal life, it means rights. At that time, the whole world will become their slaves.
"Eternal life?" Shen Yifei sneered, "Others don't know what is good about eternal life, but I have experienced it a long time ago. If possible, I would rather choose death. It's a pity that you have deprived me of the right to die."
"Is there anything wrong with this?" the man asked, "If you are immortal, you are a god in this world, and everyone must regard you as the Lord. From ancient times to the present, many emperors have longed for immortality, but you have it easily. This is a blessing given to you by God, and you should learn to be grateful."
"God? Do you want to tell me that you are God?"
The man nodded, "You are right, I am heaven, the god who rules over all living things. Surrender to me, and I can grant you life, otherwise... there will be only death. You'd better think about it carefully."
"Okay, stop talking nonsense. No matter how eloquent you are, we won't believe your nonsense. In my opinion, the best result is that you die." At this point, Shen Yifei turned to look at the other three people, "You go first and tell the people outside about what is going on here."
"What about you?"
"I'll stay and hold him back."
"No, you are no match for him!" Hai Liusha shook his head, "If we go together, we will never leave you behind."
"Let him stay and deal with the aftermath." Ji Hang said, "Don't forget, he is also an immortal."
"Hurry up!" Shen Yifei urged, tiptoeing a little, his body shaped like an arrow, he shot out of the air and rushed towards the man.
Seeing this, Shao Haisheng said in a deep voice: "Let's go. Even if we stay here, it's useless. We'd better go up and notify others."
"Haha! Can you get out? This is my world, and I am the master. No one can escape without my permission."
"That's not necessarily the case." Shen Yifei shouted violently, and a majestic momentum burst out, and dense mist surged crazily from his body and filled the air. Immediately afterwards, the dense mist spread rapidly around like tentacles. In a matter of seconds, the entire space was enveloped in mist.
Seeing this scene, Ji Hang couldn't help but open his mouth, "How did he do it?" At this moment, Shen Yifei's powerful power was everywhere in this space. Not only them, but also the man had a look of surprise on his face.
"He blew himself up in his dantian!" Shao Haisheng said with a serious look on his face. As a strong man in the divine realm, he knows very well that when a strong man in the divine realm explodes his dantian, his strength will be greatly improved. However, the terrifying strength displayed by Shen Yifei still shocked him. Logically speaking, even if one self-destructs the dantian, it is impossible to reach this level.
Everyone does not know that Shen Yifei has survived in this world for thousands of years. Although time has stopped for him and no matter how hard he tries, his cultivation level cannot be improved. However, over the years, he has accumulated countless spiritual power in his Dantian. One of the advantages of having an immortal body is that you don't have to worry about the backlash from spiritual power. Therefore, the spiritual power condensed in his body has already reached a terrifying level.
Now, when this power breaks out, the power it creates is by no means as simple as that of a powerful person in the divine realm.
As that force continued to spread, countless cracks appeared above everyone's heads, as if the entire space had been stretched open.
"What are you still doing? Let's go!"
Hearing Shen Yifei's roar, Hai Liusha and the others finally came to their senses and rushed towards the crack above their heads.
"Let me see where you are going!" the man shouted coldly, raised one hand to the sky, and slowly clenched his fingers into a fist. Following his movements, an invisible and terrifying coercion emerged from the sky and the earth, instantly covering the bodies of Hai Liusha and the others. Suddenly, the three people's bodies paused slightly, and they were imprisoned in mid-air, unable to move.
"Blow it up!" Shen Yifei's face was ferocious, with a trace of blood red all over his body, as if he had entered a violent state. As he roared, the dense mist that filled the space suddenly exploded, forming a powerful wave of air that filled the air crazily.
In the blink of an eye, the invisible pressure was dissipated. Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hai Liusha and the others quickly passed through the crack above their heads and disappeared without a trace.
…
At this time, thousands of miles away in Donglan City, Jiang Lai, who was lying on the bed to rest, suddenly sat up, then stood up and walked to the window sill, looking up into the distance, his thick eyebrows frowning slightly.
Just now, he had a strange feeling, as if the gems on his body sensed something. Not only that, the feeling is very strong. After thinking for a moment, he walked out of the guest room and knocked on the door of the next room.
"Mr. Jiang, what's the matter?" Zou Zhitong opened the door and asked.
"I think I know where your eldest lady will go." Jiang Lai said. Since he can sense it, Yu Shuixi must also be able to sense it.
